empty.body: New leads, team changes and automation alerts show up here as they happen.
empty.archivedBody: Notifications you archive are kept here.

alerts.title: New leads, outside the app
alerts.intro: Hear about a visitor while it still matters. These are only for new leads from your cards.
alerts.whatsappHint: A message on WhatsApp for each new lead, with a button to open it.
alerts.notReady: Not set up on this server yet. Ask whoever runs Vertex Connect to connect WhatsApp.
alerts.removed: Number removed. WhatsApp alerts are off.
alerts.badPhone: Enter the number with its country code, like +20 100 123 4567.
alerts.testSent: Test sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
alerts.testFailed: WhatsApp didn't accept the message. Check the number and try again.
alerts.tooMany: Too many tests for now. Try again later.
alerts.weeklyHint: Every Sunday morning by email: the week's leads, taps and meetings against the week before, who is waiting for a reply, and the team's best.
alerts.weeklyNow: Send me this week's report now
alerts.reportQuiet: Sent to {{address}}. It was a quiet week, so there's little in it.

prefs.intro: Choose what shows up here. Turning a type off stops new ones; the ones you have stay.
prefs.CRM: When someone shares their details from one of your cards.
prefs.ORGANIZATION: People joining or leaving, your role, teams and workspace settings.
prefs.SECURITY: Changes to your own access, like a suspension.
prefs.SYSTEM: Automation alerts and deliveries that failed.

types.automationFailedBody: Some of its actions failed on “{{event}}”.
types.memberAdded: You were added to the workspace
types.followUpNoName: A lead is waiting for a reply

push.title: On this device
push.intro: Notifications on this phone or computer's lock screen, even with the app closed. They follow the categories above.
push.label: Notifications on this device
push.hint: A new lead or meeting request reaches you the moment it arrives.
push.testSent: Sent. It should appear in a moment.
push.failed: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then come back here.
push.unsupported: This browser can't show notifications. Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox, or the installed app.
push.iosInstall: On iPhone, add Vertex to your Home Screen first: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen". Open it from there and turn notifications on.
push.installHint: Vertex on your home screen, opening in its own window.
push.promptTitle: Know the moment a lead arrives
push.promptBody: Turn on notifications on this device, and new leads and meeting requests reach you even with the app closed.
